Links out to production history, work order process distribution and work order process BOM.

props.label: Code
props.description: Label field, code to track the work order process.

props.label: Product
props.description: Product object

props.label: Product Strategy
props.description: Product strategy object

props.label: Quantity
props.description: The desired output quantity for the overall Work Order.

props.label: Scheduled Start At
props.description: The date this work order is scheduled to start production - System Generated

props.label: Scheduled Finish At
props.description: The date this work order is scheduled to finish production - System Generated

props.label: Actual Start At
props.description: Actual Date/Time of the intiail 'setup' of the first process distribution of the Work Order.

props.label: Actual Finish At
props.description: Actual Date/Time of the final Work Order Processes, final distribution, or the date/time of when/if a Work Order was prematurely closed via status change of the Work Order.

props.label: Transaction At
props.description: What is the transaction date?

props.label: Promise At
props.description: The Date/Time of the overall Work Order - this field describes the general Due Date, or Date upon which you expect all inventory to be available pertaining to this Work Order. Also considered to be a proposed Due Date.

props.label: Facility
props.description: Facility object

props.label: Work Order Group
props.description: The work order group object.

props.label: Work Order Type
props.description: Work order type object

props.label: Order
props.description: Order number

transforms.pre:
{
  "payload": [$components.UpdateForm.data.{
    "update":{  
      "code": workOrder & "-" & order & "-" & process.name,
      "controlPanelId": controlPanel.id,
      "documentDesignId": documentDesign.id,
      "standardPositions": standardPositions,
      "standardWorkcenters":standardWorkcenters,
      "cycleTime":cycleTime,
      "distributionPercentage": distributionPercentage,
      "idealRate":idealRate,
      "leadTime":leadTime,
      "minimumProductionRunTime":minimumProductionRunTime,
      "percentToStart":percentToStart,
      "productionOffalAllowed":productionOffalAllowed,
      "productionOperators":$coalesce([productionOperators,1]),
      "quantity":quantity,
      "quantityToStart":quantityToStart,
      "quotedRate":quotedRate,
      "setupOffalAllowed":setupOffalAllowed,
      "setupOperators":$coalesce([setupOperators,0]),
      "setupRate":$coalesce([setupRate,0]),
      "standardRate":$coalesce([standardRate,0]),
      "timeToStart":timeToStart,
      "transitTimeAfter":transitTimeAfter,
      "transitTimeBefore":transitTimeBefore,
      "unitPerCycle":$coalesce([unitPerCyle,1]),
      "unitWeight":unitWeight,
      "allowMixedLots":allowMixedLots,
      "final":final,
      "finishedGood":finishedGood,
      "generatePurchaseOrder":generatePurchaseOrder,
      "maintenance":maintenance,
      "rawMaterial":rawMaterial,
      "requireReceipt":requireReceipt,
      "transferSerial":transferSerial,
      "useSupplierLabel":useSupplierLabel,
      "useWorkcenterRates":useWorkcenterRates,
      "wip":wip,
      "externalId":externalId,
      "order":order,
      "customData":customData,
      "integrationData":integrationData,
      "processId":process.id,
      "workOrderProcessStatusId":workOrderProcessStatus.id,
      "lotControlId":lotControl.id,
      "productStrategyId":productStrategy.id,
      "productStrategyProcessId":productStrategyProcess.id,
      "productionTypeId":productionType.id,
      "putAwayLocationId":putAwayLocation.id,
      "schedulingGroupId":schedulingGroup.id,
      "weightUnitId":weightUnit.id,
      "workcenterId":workcenter.id
    },
  "where": {
    "id":id
  }
  }]
}

props.label: Work Order Process Status
props.description: Work order process status object

props.label: Finished Good
props.description: From productStrategyProcess "finishedGood" boolean indicating finished good

props.label: Id
props.description: The primary unique ID of the record.  Every model should have an id field.

props.label: Quantity
props.description: The quantity of the Process. Should be same as the WorkOrder Quantity

props.label: Setup Rate
props.description: The amount of time setup takes.  This is always in terms of "Hours" .

props.label: Standard Rate
props.description: The standard rate represents the typically expected production rate at this workcenter. Taking into account typical downtime, material shortages, etc. This rate is used for planning purposes, but not used for OEE calculations. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.

props.label: Unit Per Cycle
props.description: Quantity produced per cycle

props.label: Unit Weight
props.description: Weight per unit (DEFAULT = 0)

props.label: Id
props.description: The primary unique ID of the record.  Every model should have an id field.

props.label: External Id
props.description: Links to a similar record in another system

props.label: Order
props.description: Order number

props.label: Production Operators
props.description: The number of operators required to use the work center for production.

props.label: Quantity To Start
props.description: Required quantity (in productStrategy.consumtionUnit) until successor process can start (or in case of auto will start). For use with  startToStart =true dependency types.

props.label: Quoted Rate
props.description: The Quoted Rate represents the target value that you may have used for estimating or quoting this project to your customer. This can be used to evaluate how close you are between your target and actual production. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.

props.label: Setup Offal Allowed
props.description:
Offal Allowance indicates the variance allowed when the workcenter is in a setup mode - for scrap / offal production. The variance can be a % of the Work Order Qty, Fixed Qty or Fixed Qty/Work Order Qty. This will be considered in the Work Order Completion algorithm.
Global: Set on Process
Product Specific: Set on Strategy Process
Workcenter Specific: Set on Workcenter
Process-Workcenter Specific: Set on approved workcenter

(REQUIRED, DEFAULT = 0)

props.label: Setup Operators
props.description: The number of operators required to setup the work center for this product.

props.label: Time To Start
props.description: Required time in seconds until successor process can start (or in case of auto will start). For use with  startToStart =true dependency types.
